title: CV Writing and Interview Skills
description: For school leavers looking for their first job, internship or attachment. You will write a strong CV even with little experience, apply safely, and walk into interviews prepared and confident.
outcomes: Write a clear one- or two-page CV that shows your skills and achievements
Write a short cover letter tailored to a specific job
Set up a professional LinkedIn profile
Search for jobs safely and spot common job scams
Answer common interview questions using the STAR method
Handle online interviews and follow up professionally
